output.summary: An evergreen tree native to the Brazilian states of Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Goiás and São Paulo. Its round, purplish-black fruit grows directly on the trunk and contains sweet white or pink flesh; it is eaten raw or made into preserves, juice and alcoholic drinks.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit is eaten raw or made into jellies, jams, juice, wine, tarts and liqueurs; it has been cultivated in Brazil since pre-Columbian times.
